stb_image.h is vendored from https://github.com/nothings/stb at commit
f0569113c93ad095470c54bf34a17b36646bbbb5. Its MIT/public-domain license
is included at the end of the header. Only PNG decoding is enabled, for
the mouse cursor artwork; no additional runtime library is required.

TinySoundFont v0.9 (tsf.h) is vendored from
https://github.com/schellingb/TinySoundFont (retrieved 2026-11-06).
Its MIT license is included in the header and packaging/TinySoundFont-LICENSE.txt.
It supplies optional SF2 instrument rendering; no system synthesizer is required.
